question: Name the album for which Pandit Ravi Shankar won the Grammy award in 1967.
solution:
The correct answer is __**West Meets East.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Yehudi Menuhin, **an American violinist, and** Ravi Shankar,** an Indian sitar virtuoso, collaborated on the **1967 British album West Meets East.**
 
• Following their well-received duet at the **Bath Musical Festival in June 1966,** it was recorded.
 
• Pandit Ravi Shankar won the** Grammy award in 1967** for this album.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Three Ragas:**

 
 
• **Ravi Shankar,** a Hindustani classical musician, released** Three Ragas on vinyl in 1956.**
 
• Matthew Greenwald, an** AllMusic reviewer, complimented** the CD as a **"great introduction to the medium of Indian music"** and appreciated the rendition of the raga Jog.
 
 
 
• **Concert for Bangladesh:**
 
 
• The triple live album The Concert for Bangladesh bears the **"George Harrison & Friends" credit.**
 
 
 
• **Full circle:**
 
 
• The** Doors, an American rock band**, released its eighth studio album, Full Circle, in **August 1972.**
